Neural-network prediction and image/time-series/text evaluation; no assumed clinical-data project or diagnostic qualification.

Calculus/ODEs and actual dynamic-model project support quantitative biological inquiry; not full biological-system modelling formation.

Rigorous probability/inference and sampling simulation support biomedical evidence, not clinical data collection.
